SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.PATIENT) AS patients, COUNT(DISTINCT p.DESCRIPTION) AS procedures, COUNT(DISTINCT m.DESCRIPTION) AS medicines
FROM encounters e
LEFT JOIN procedures p ON p.PATIENT=e.PATIENT
LEFT JOIN medications m ON m.PATIENT=e.PATIENT
WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION='Drug overdose';

SELECT DISTINCT p.DESCRIPTION AS procedure, m.DESCRIPTION AS medicine
FROM encounters e
JOIN procedures p ON p.PATIENT = e.PATIENT
JOIN medications m ON m.PATIENT = e.PATIENT
WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose';
